description: Rebuild the React frontend to match all 4 mockup screens exactly (Tasks #10-13 from spec). Implement slide studio (3-step), video studio (4-step), hub page with cost column, and login page. Include SSML cheatsheet movable panel, output size options, subtitle modes, and cost display.
steps: Rewrite frontend/src/App.tsx with React Router routes: / (login), /home (hub), /slide-studio (slide creation), /video-studio (video creation)
Rewrite frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx matching mockup/index.html: email/password form, SSO button, language toggle (ja/en), show password checkbox, forgot password and signup links
Create frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx matching mockup/home.html: two entry cards (slide studio, video studio), recent projects table with cost column (推定コスト), project status badges

Create frontend/src/pages/SlideStudioPage.tsx matching mockup/slide-studio.html: 3-step wizard (input -> outline review -> generate/export). Step 1: content language selector (ja/en separate from UI language), topic, source text, reference URLs (add/remove), audience, pages, tone, theme. Step 2: outline list with reorder/add/delete, per-slide title+body+notes editing, AI badge. Step 3: thumbnail grid, download buttons (MD/PDF/PPTX), cost table.

Create frontend/src/pages/VideoStudioPage.tsx matching mockup/video-studio.html: 4-step wizard. Step 1: file upload (PDF/PPTX), handoff from slide studio, page thumbnails. Step 2: aspect ratio selection (16:9/9:16/1:1/4:5) with vertical options (layout, bg color, safe area), fps, subtitle mode (burn/srt/none), subtitle size/position, voice settings (id, engine, sample rate, speed). Step 3: narration editor with page list, plain/SSML mode toggle, SSML toolbar (sub/phoneme/say-as/break/prosody/emphasis/cheatsheet), character counter, estimated duration, pronunciation dictionary table. Step 4: 5-stage progress bar, result display with video preview and specs, download buttons (MP4/SRT/audio), cost table.

Create frontend/src/components/SsmlCheatsheet.tsx: movable/resizable floating panel (dialog role, aria-modal=false). Draggable header, close button, table of SSML tags with support status per engine. Tags show enabled/disabled based on selected voice+engine. Keyboard accessible (arrow keys to move).
Update frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts with all i18n keys from mockup HTML (data-i18n attributes) for both ja and en
Update frontend/src/api/client.ts to call all 11 API endpoints from section 5
Update frontend/src/api/types.ts with request/response types matching the API
Create frontend/src/components/StepWizard.tsx for the step navigation pattern used in both studios
Create frontend/src/components/CostTable.tsx for the cost display pattern (stage/service/usage/estimate columns, total row, 'pending' actual label)
Add frontend unit tests: component rendering for each page, navigation between steps, SSML toolbar state based on engine, language switching
Ensure frontend builds and tests pass
acceptance_criteria: Login page has email/password, SSO, language toggle matching mockup
Hub page shows two entry cards and recent projects table with cost column
Slide studio has 3 steps with outline editing (reorder/add/delete/edit)
Video studio has 4 steps with all output options from mockup
SSML cheatsheet is a movable floating panel that does not block the editor
SSML toolbar buttons are disabled when tags are unsupported by selected engine
UI language (ja/en) and content language are independent
Output size selection includes 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 with vertical-specific options
Cost tables show estimated amounts with 'pending' for actual
All buttons/inputs from mockup connect to corresponding actions (no dead UI)
verification: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd /projects/sandbox/slide-first-ai-video && pnpm build && pnpm test
findings: Simplified i18n system from complex type-safe MessageCatalog with formatter functions to a simpler flat key-value approach (Record<MessageKey, string>) since the mockups only use simple strings. Removed aws-amplify/ui-react Authenticator from LoginPage in favor of a custom login form matching the mockup. Removed authenticator.ts dependency from LanguageContext. All 291 tests pass across the workspace (41 frontend). The old Layout component was removed since the protected layout is now inline in App.tsx with the correct header structure from mockups.
